login.title: Sign in
login.notVerified: Confirm your email before signing in. The link is in the message we sent you.
login.resent: If that address can be used, we have sent the link again.

register.title: Create an account
register.intro: You need an email address and a password. Everything else is optional.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A few unrelated words work well.
register.displayNameHint: Optional. Shown only to you, and to a person you later choose to share with.
register.ageHint: This app is for adults. It does not collect data from anyone under 18.
register.ageRequired: Confirm that you are 18 or older to continue.
register.limits: This app is not therapy and is not monitored by anyone.
register.sentBody: If that address can be used, we have sent a link to it. Open the link to confirm your email, then sign in.
register.sentNote: The link works for 3 days. Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder, or sign in to send it again.

verify.title: Confirming your email
verify.done: Your email is confirmed. You can sign in now.
verify.failed: This link is not valid or has expired. Sign in to have a new one sent.
verify.missing: This page needs the link from your email. Open the link in the message we sent you.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email address and we will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. It works for 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.
reset.missing: This page needs the link from your email. Request a new reset link.

validation.email: Enter an email address, like name@example.com.
